text:
You need a modern, user-friendly redesign of HeyInternet that can be turned from a high-fidelity mockup into a responsive web app.

I’m Tobias Reyne, a full-stack developer with 7 years of experience building polished web interfaces and production-ready applications. I work across JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST API, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, HTML, and CSS, and I’m comfortable moving from design-focused mockups into clean implementation.

For your project, I’d start by getting a clear understanding of the current app flow, the core user tasks, and the pain points you want to improve. From there, I’d create a detailed mockup that prioritizes clarity, hierarchy, and usability, so you can review the interface before any development begins. Once the design is approved, I’d translate it into a responsive application with maintainable code and careful attention to layout consistency across devices and browsers.

A relevant project I’ve worked on was a Restaurant ordering web app for Saffron Lane Kitchens. I built an installable ordering app for 9 restaurants that kept the menu and cart working on bad connections. The result was that 22% of orders were coming through the app within 2 months. That project required a strong focus on user experience, reliability, and making the interface practical in real-world conditions.

For HeyInternet, I’d approach the redesign with the same mindset: make the interface feel modern, reduce friction, and keep the experience smooth from first use through repeated use. I also value clear communication, so I’d keep you updated throughout both the mockup and development phases and make sure the final handoff is organized and easy to maintain.

If needed, I can help shape the timeline into two phases: one for the mockup and one for the build, based on the complexity of the current app and the scope of the redesign.

What are the main user flows in HeyInternet that you want improved first?
